The patient, Patrick Smith, presents with symptoms including palpitations, weight loss, reduced libido, and severe headaches, which emerged following a job change to a high-pressure legal position. The symptoms may be related to a thyroid hormone imbalance, possibly exacerbated by the stress of his new job environment. Precipitating factors include the high-level stress inherent in his occupation and inadequate thyroid hormone management. Perpetuating factors may involve ongoing occupational stress and possible thyroxine dose issues. Protective factors were not recorded in the transcript.
